name: file.delete
description: Delete a file. Files only — use `directory.delete` for directories. Hard delete — bypasses Recycle Bin / Trash.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`.

x-implementations.name: delete_file_w
x-implementations.description: Win32 `DeleteFileW`. Returns ERR permission_denied for read-only files (caller must clear FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY first via a future file.set_attributes verb). Returns ERR not_a_directory if path resolves to a directory — use directory.delete instead.

x-implementations.name: delete_file_a
x-implementations.description: Win32 `DeleteFileA` legacy fallback for NT 4 / 9x. ANSI path; transcoded UTF-8 → ANSI by the agent.

windows-modern.description: DeleteFileW. Hard delete — does not route through the Recycle Bin (SHFileOperation is intentionally NOT used). Returns ERR not_a_directory if path is a directory; the caller must use directory.delete instead.

windows-classic.description: DeleteFileW on NT 5+; DeleteFileA on NT 4 / 9x. Same hard-delete behaviour. Returns ERR not_a_directory if path is a directory.
